name: Uta
source:
Uta is a ghoul and an old friend of [url=/c73118]Yomo Renji[/url] and [url=/c73568]Itori[/url]. He owns the HySy ArtMask Studio, where he sells masks, whilst also being a member of the Clowns. He is known as No Face (ノーフェイス) to the CCG investigators. 

[From [url=http://tokyoghoul.wikia.com/wiki/Uta]Tokyo Ghoul Wikia[/url]]
